description: This file defines a Java class 'ConnectionSupervisorActor' which manages supervision for the 'ConnectionPersistenceActor'. It handles actor creation, supervision strategy, restarts with exponential back-off, and shutdown behavior within an Akka-based system related to Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging.

classes.name: ConnectionSupervisorActor
classes.description: Supervisor actor managing ConnectionPersistenceActor with restart strategies and supervision for Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for actor instantiation with configured supervision and restart strategies.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Generates Props for a new ConnectionPersistenceActor.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Retrieves back-off configuration from system settings.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Defines shutdown behavior during actor termination.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Provides exception builder for connection unavailability.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervisor restart policy for child actors.
